1.consolidated_definition: mús. Género musical popular de ritmo afronorteamericano creado a principios del siglo XX en Nueva Orleans. Anglicismo crudo, usual. DRAE 2001, voz inglesa. Se introdujeron en la orquesta nuevos instrumentos derivados del jazz norteamericano (Silvestrini y )
1.en_consolidated_definition: Musical genre. A popular musical style of African-North American rhythm created in the early 20th century in New Orleans. Raw Anglicism, usual. Introduced into the orchestra were new instruments derived from North American jazz (Silvestrini and others).
